nodes.description: Public address state variable storing the contract owner, used by the restricted modifier.
Public uint tracking the last completed migration; written by setCompleted and forwarded during upgrade.
Constructor Migrations() that initializes the owner state variable.
restricted function setCompleted(uint completed) that writes last_completed_migration.
restricted function upgrade(address new_address) that constructs a Migrations instance and calls setCompleted on it.
Modifier restricted() that only allows execution when msg.sender equals owner.
msg.sender global caller value used for owner assignment and access-control comparison.
Parameter completed of setCompleted, the value written into last_completed_migration.
Parameter new_address of upgrade, an attacker-influenced address converted into a contract instance.
Local Migrations instance created from new_address, used as the external call target.
External call upgraded.setCompleted(last_completed_migration) to an arbitrary address, enabling reentrancy/unauthorized state changes.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner directly from the untrusted msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
The restricted modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
The constructor writes the owner state variable.
The restricted modifier controls whether setCompleted can execute.
The restricted modifier controls whether upgrade can execute.
Parameter completed flows into the setCompleted function body.
setCompleted writes its argument into the last_completed_migration state variable.
Parameter new_address is used to construct the local Migrations instance upgraded.
The local instance derived from new_address is the receiver of the external call.
Current stored last_completed_migration value is passed into the external call.
upgrade performs the external call to an arbitrary address as its final statement.
Caller-supplied new_address determines the destination of the unsafe external call.
The external call can re-enter setCompleted on this or another instance and mutate last_completed_migration.
Re-entrancy through the external call can indirectly modify the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter has no independent semantics outside setCompleted and should be folded into that function node.
new_address exists only to select the target of the unsafe external call and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
The local upgraded instance is a transient handle for the external call and should be absorbed into the unsafe operation node.
